expects.rule: The ages accepted are stated on the first screen or next to each programme (for example 3 months to 3 years).
Opening hours, session lengths (full day, half day) and closure weeks are written as text.
Fees are published, with what they include (meals, nappies) and the subsidies or public funding that reduce them.
One clear next step for parents: book a visit, register interest or check availability, with a short form.
Inspection results, licence or registration number and staff qualifications are shown, with a link to the official report.
Photographs of children are of the real setting and used with consent; faces of identifiable children are limited.
For activities and play venues: price per child and per adult, booking requirement and session times are on the booking page before payment.

traits: 5 of 6 sites read state the ages accepted (Vaikystes Sodas 1-6, Rainbow babies to school age, Little Skool-House 2 months-6 years, Maria Montessori Institute 2½-16 by site, MoPA 1-7 in the top banner); Kita Sunnastrahl does not on the home page.
3 of 6 give hours as text (Kita Sunnastrahl Mon-Fri 7-18, Vaikystes Sodas 8:30-17:30, Rainbow 7:00-18:00 with half-day and extended sessions); MoPA says only 'open every day'.
2 of 6 show a fee figure on the home page (Little Skool-House 'fees from $408.50 after subsidy' in the hero, MoPA '$6 visits' and memberships from $82); 3 others link to a fees page or PDF.

4 of 6 lead parents to registration rather than contact (Kita 'Mein Kind anmelden', Vaikystes 'Registracija', Little Skool-House 'Register interest', MoPA 'Book Tickets'); 3 of 6 offer a visit or tour (Kita, Vaikystes, Maria Montessori Institute).
3 of 6 show named parent testimonials or a rating (Kita two, Vaikystes three, Rainbow one plus a 4.8 Google rating).
3 of 6 use illustration or decorative shapes alongside photographs (Kita, Rainbow, MoPA).

sites.name: Kita Sunnastrahl
sites.why: Daycare in Arosa, Switzerland, in German: headline 'Wo Kinderfüsse die Welt entdecken, schritt für schritt', buttons 'Mein Kind anmelden', 'Kita Besichtigung' and 'Kita-Platz reservieren', parent menu with registration, costs, hours and a tariff PDF, hours Mon-Fri 7:00-18:00, phone and email, two named parent testimonials, coloured leaf and flower shapes over photos of children outdoors.

sites.name: Vaikystės sodas
sites.why: Private kindergarten network in Lithuania, in Lithuanian: three named parent testimonials first, 'Pasimatuokite Sodelį!' with a Registracija button for an individual meeting, short answer blocks 'Why us?', 'Where are we?' (Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda, Panevėžys), 'Whom do we accept?' (ages 1 to 6), 'What do we cost?' linking 2025/2026 fees, phone and weekday hours 8:30-17:30.

sites.name: Rainbow Nursery
sites.why: Nursery, early learning centre and out-of-school club in Bathgate, Scotland: headline 'Rain or shine, look for the rainbow', rooms named by colour, ages per setting, hours Mon-Fri 7:00-18:00 with half-day and extended sessions, funded places with West Lothian Council, both addresses and phone, 4.8 Google rating, staff portraits. Footer links point to '#'. The award was for an earlier version of the site.

sites.name: Little Skool-House
sites.why: Preschool and childcare group in Singapore: hero 'Little Skool-House has 14 POP centres islandwide!' with 'fees from $408.50* after working mother subsidy', '2027 ENROLMENT NOW OPEN', Register interest repeated, programmes by age (2 months-3 years, 4-6 years), figures with sources (93% bilingual proficiency, 96% parent satisfaction, 2026 survey), Find one near you. No phone on the home page.

sites.name: Maria Montessori Institute
sites.why: London charity running a Montessori school (2½ to 16, three sites with ages per site) and teacher training: headline 'Making the World a Better Place. One Child at a Time.', school menu with Visit, Apply, School Fees, Term Dates and 'Ofsted & Parent Views', upcoming school tours listed, parent-toddler group named. No phone number on the home page.

sites.name: MoPA, Museum of Play and Art
sites.why: Play museum for ages 1-7 with five Australian locations: top banner 'MUSEUM FOR AGES 1-7 BOOKINGS ESSENTIAL OPEN EVERY DAY', Book Tickets button, Book Now menu (play, party, excursions, memberships, venue hire), '$6 MoPA Visits' headline, memberships from $82, gift cards from $30, hot-weather policy in the footer. No hours or street address on the home page.

sites.name: Metropolitan Montessori School
sites.why: Montessori school in New York for children aged 2 to 14, per the listing; site built by Manoverboard Inc. The live site could not be read (certificate error), so no headline, buttons or fees were checked. (not seen beyond the gallery listing)

avoid: Ages accepted missing from the home page, so parents must open several pages to know if their child qualifies.
'Contact us for fees' with no figure and no mention of public subsidies.
Stock photographs of children that are clearly not the setting.
Footer or menu links that point to '#'.
A registration flow that asks for the child's full details before the parent has seen hours, fees or availability.
Inspection or licence information hidden or missing.
A play venue that requires booking but shows no session times or ticket price before the checkout.
